backlight.description: Empty: auto-detect at start. Restart the plugin after changing.
backlight.label: Backlight device

colortemp.description: Warm the panel toward ambient. WARNING: forces night light on and rewrites temperature_night.
colortemp.label: Adaptive colour temperature

connector.description: Empty: auto-detect at start. Restart the plugin after changing.
connector.label: Output

curve_brightness.description: Override: node per row, "reading:target" or "target". Edit a row and this map replaces the sliders; defaults match them.
curve_brightness.label: Brightness map (advanced)

curve_temperature.description: Same shape. Panel kelvin, lower is warmer. Only used with adaptive colour temperature.
curve_temperature.label: Temperature map (advanced)

enabled.description: Off: the panel is left alone.
enabled.label: Enable

kbd_anchor_percent.description: The panel percent whose ambient crossing defines the keyboard threshold. It tracks the curve you tuned.
kbd_anchor_percent.label: Keyboard threshold anchor

kbd_buffer_percent.description: Hysteresis half-width as a fraction of the threshold: how far ambient must travel before the keyboard changes state again.
kbd_buffer_percent.label: Keyboard hysteresis width

kbd_dark_percent.description: The level the keyboard runs at in the dark. Zero means automatic: the lowest level that is not off.
kbd_dark_percent.label: Keyboard dark level

keyboard_backlight.description: On: the keyboard backlight follows the ambient light, on in the dark and off in the light. Off: left alone.
keyboard_backlight.label: Keyboard backlight

learning_profile.description: On: apply thresholds learned from your changes. Off: use the sliders as set. Recording is always on.
learning_profile.label: Use learned thresholds

show_advanced.description: Show the raw curve map editors.
show_advanced.label: Advanced maps
